messages:
ana: Quick design sync — prompt-sets & evals UI. Need decisions on: 1) bulk-approve undo affordance 2) compact vs annotated regression diffs 3) scorecard legend clarity 4) screenreader/keyboard flows. Posting comps: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (frames 12-18) :eyes:
kevin: LGTM. For bulk approve, can we have a 5s undo toast? avoids modal friction.
maria: 5s undo feels short for some org flows. What about 'Undo' plus an optional email confirmation for org-admins?
ana: @maria good point. I'd prefer an in-UI undo + a short confirmation for >100 items.
tom: Accessibility nit: if we do toast undo, make sure it's announced to SR users and keyboard focus restored to the table row. Also need role=alert on the toast.
kevin: Agreed. Implement role=alert and set aria-live=assertive. Also track focus with `element.focus()` after undo completes.
eva-bot: Automated contrast check: compact-diff side-by-side labels fail AA at small text. Suggest color tweak or bold weight.
maria: Yikes, contrast fail. Suggest using #0b1f3a for diff labels or bump to 14px semibold for compact mode.
nana: For compact vs annotated diffs — product question: do we default to compact for power users? Or annotated for reviewers?
kevin: I vote default annotated for first-time viewers, with a 'compact' toggle persisted in user prefs.
maria: UX: annotated mode should collapse identical groups by default to reduce noise.
tom: Keyboard: ensure collapse/expand has accessible names and arrowkey support. Use `aria-expanded` + roving tabindex.
nana: Scorecard legend: multiple PMs said the "neutral" state was confusing. Current copy: "No judgement yet". Propose: "Not scored" -> clearer.
kevin: +1 to "Not scored". Also add tooltip that explains score mapping (0-5 scale) and default weights.
maria: Microcopy for approve modal: current draft -> `Approve 18 results`. Proposed -> `Approve 18 examples — this will mark them as passed in this suite. You can undo via the banner.`
nana: Love that. Short and explicit.
kevin: Edge case: bulk approving >1k items — we should show an async job indicator and rate-limit UI.
maria: For huge jobs, show a 'processing' card in top-right with estimated time and job id for audit logs.
tom: A11y: when job completes, trigger a polite `aria-live` message. For failures, assertive + link to logs.
eva-bot: Regression test alert: keyboard-only flow in compact-diff modal fails when using table row inline comments. Failing test id: rs-compact-042.
kevin: I'll pick this up. Likely a tabindex/stop-propagation issue. ETA EOD.
maria: Small copy nit: bulk-select label currently "Select all in view". Change to "Select all in view (approx N)". Avoid implying exactness.
nana: Good call. Metrics team wants exact counts for billing so we must be careful.
kevin: PR when ready. I'll add unit tests for toast announce + keyboard focus. @tom can you review a11y bits?
tom: Yep, ping me when it's up. Also can someone add a quick screenreader walkthrough to the QA checklist?
maria: I'll add it.
nana: Thanks all — I'll update the Figma and push new copy. Quick poll: thumbs if you agree with default annotated + compact toggle. :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
tom: :thumbsup:
nana: Thanks — closing this thread once PRs are linked.
